---
title: "STAR Alignment Versus Bowtie2 End-to-End Alignment: distribution of uniquely mapped and unmapped reads"
output: html_notebook
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

Get STAR alignment metrics PFAS
```{r}
star_pfas <- read.csv("~/Documents/School/thesis/PFAS_project_preprocessing_pipeline/Results_from_pipeline/from_multiqc/star_alignment_plot_pfas.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
head(star_pfas)
```




Get Bowtie end2end alignment v2 metrics PFAS
```{r}
bowtie_pfasv2 <- read.csv("~/Documents/School/thesis/PFAS_project_preprocessing_pipeline/Results_from_pipeline/from_multiqc/bowtie2_se_plot_pfasv2.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
head(bowtie_pfasv2)
```

Get Bowtie end2end alignment v1.2 metrics PFAS
```{r}
bowtie_pfasv1.2 <- read.csv("~/Documents/School/thesis/PFAS_project_preprocessing_pipeline/Results_from_pipeline/from_multiqc/bowtie2_se_plot_pfasv1.2.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
head(bowtie_pfasv1.2)
```
```{r}
star_long <- star_pfas %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(-sample)),
         not_aligned = rowSums(across(starts_with("Unmapped")))) %>%
  transmute(sample, tool = "STAR", total,
            uniq_reads = `Uniquely mapped`, na_reads = not_aligned)

bowtie_longv2 <- bowtie_pfasv2 %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  mutate(sample = sub("_bowtie$", "", sample),
         total = rowSums(across(-sample))) %>%
  transmute(sample, tool = "Bowtie2 v1.2", total,
            uniq_reads = `SE mapped uniquely`, na_reads = `SE not aligned`)

bowtie_longv1.2 <- bowtie_pfasv1.2 %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  mutate(sample = sub("_bowtie$", "", sample),
         total = rowSums(across(-sample))) %>%
  transmute(sample, tool = "Bowtie2 v2", total,
            uniq_reads = `SE mapped uniquely`, na_reads = `SE not aligned`)

star_long$tool        <- "STAR"
bowtie_longv2$tool    <- "Bowtie2 v2"
bowtie_longv1.2$tool  <- "Bowtie2 v1.2"

cmp <- bind_rows(star_long, bowtie_longv1.2, bowtie_longv2) %>%
  mutate(uniq_pct = 100 * uniq_reads / total,
         na_pct   = 100 * na_reads / total,
         tool = factor(tool, levels = c("STAR", "Bowtie2 v1.2", "Bowtie2 v2")))

plot_cmp <- function(cols, ylab, title=NULL, log = FALSE) {
  d <- cmp %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(names(cols)), names_to = "category", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(category = recode(category, !!!cols))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(tool, value, fill = tool)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(group = sample), color = "grey60", alpha = 0.04) +
    # geom_point(alpha = 0.1, size = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.8, shape = 16) +
    facet_wrap(~category, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, title = title) +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")
  if (log) p <- p + scale_y_log10()
  p}


# Percentages
plot_cmp(c(uniq_pct = "Uniquely mapped", na_pct = "Not aligned"), "% of reads",
         title = "STAR vs Bowtie2 end-to-end alignment rates manifest v1.2 & 2 (PFAS Dataset)")

# Read counts
plot_cmp(c(uniq_reads = "Uniquely mapped", na_reads = "Not aligned"), "Reads", 
         title = "STAR vs Bowtie2 end-to-end read counts manifest v1.2 & 2 (PFAS Dataset)", log = TRUE)
```

# compare end-to-end vs local
import pfas 1.2 local
(bowtie_pfasv1.2 is the end2end one)
```{r}

bowtie_pfasv1.2_local <- read.csv("~/Documents/School/thesis/PFAS_project_preprocessing_pipeline/Results_from_pipeline/from_multiqc/bowtie2_se_plot_pfas1.2_local.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
bowtie_longv1.2_end <- bowtie_pfasv1.2 %>%

cmp <- bind_rows(bowtie_longv1.2_local, bowtie_longv1.2_end) %>%

    facet_wrap(~category, scales = "free_y") +
```
